title: An-Nazi'at 79:25-32 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 29 (Pupil PDF worksheet: An-Nazi'at 79:25-32 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 29. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ (٢٥) إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ (٢٦) ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا (٢٧) رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا (٢٨) وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا (٢٩) وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ (٣٠) أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا (٣١) وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا (٣٢)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].
Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
And after that He spread the earth.
He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
And the mountains He set firmly

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Heavy خ and ق; tanween at a stop becomes alif

questions.q: Chunk and link An-Nazi'at 79:25-32 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 79:25-32 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:25-32 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.
Thirty-two ayat recited; partner notes slips.

questions.q: How do 79:27 to 33 answer the deniers of 79:10 to 12?
questions.a: The One who made the sky and earth can surely bring people back to life.
A) the mountains. 79:32: 'And the mountains He set firmly.'

questions.q: Think again: 'Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven?' (79:27). What does looking at the sky do to your sense of your own size?
questions.a: It makes us humble: Allah who made the vast sky can easily recreate us.
